13:["$","$L14",null,{"title":"Why AI Thinks in Tokens Instead of Words","summary":"Large language models do not experience language the way humans do. 12:[["$","h1",null,{"children":"Why AI Thinks in Tokens Instead of Words"}],"\n",["$","blockquote",null,{"children":["\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"Humans experience language as meaning."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"Large language models experience it as probability, structure, and prediction."}],"\n"]}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"When most people use systems like ChatGPT, they instinctively imagine something human-like happening inside the machine."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":["A sentence enters.",["$","br",null,{}],"\n","The AI “understands” it.",["$","br",null,{}],"\n","A response appears."]}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"But internally, modern language models operate in a radically different way."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"The system does not fundamentally perceive:"}],"\n",["$","blockquote",null,{"children":["\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"“Hello, how are you?”"}],"\n"]}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"as a complete human sentence carrying meaning."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"Instead, language is transformed into smaller mathematical fragments called:"}],"\n",["$","h1",null,{"children":"tokens"}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"And those tokens become the true building blocks through which modern AI systems process language, code, mathematics, logic, and reasoning-like behavior itself."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"What sounds like a technical implementation detail is actually one of the deepest ideas in artificial intelligence."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"Because tokens reveal something profoundly strange:"}],"\n",["$","h1",null,{"children":"language itself may be far more mathematical than humans intuitively realize."}],"\n",["$","hr",null,{}],"\n",["$","h2",null,{"children":"The Machine Does Not Truly See Words"}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"A token is a small unit of information processed by a language model."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":["Sometimes a token is an entire word.",["$","br",null,{}],"\n","Sometimes it is only part of one."]}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"The word:"}],"\n",["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-txt","children":"unbelievable\n"}]}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"may internally become:"}],"\n",["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-txt","children":"un\nbelieve\nable\n"}]}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"Likewise, a word such as:"}],"\n",["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-txt","children":"mathematics\n"}]}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"might be represented through reusable fragments like:"}],"\n",["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-txt","children":"math\nematics\n"}]}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"The exact division depends on the tokenizer used by the model, but the underlying principle remains the same:"}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"the AI does not fundamentally operate on sentences."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"It operates on token sequences."}],"\n",["$","hr",null,{}],"\n",["$","h2",null,{"children":"Why Entire Words Would Not Work"}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"At first glance, it might seem obvious that AI systems should simply process complete words."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"But human language is too enormous, unstable, and flexible for that approach to scale efficiently."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"Even a single root word can generate massive variation:"}],"\n",["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-txt","children":"mathematics\nmathematical\nmathematician\nmathematically\nantimathematical\n"}]}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"And this complexity expands dramatically once language includes slang, spelling mistakes, scientific notation, emojis, URLs, source code, or multilingual text."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"If every possible word had to exist independently inside the model’s vocabulary, the system would become extraordinarily inefficient."}],"\n",["$","p",null,{"children":"Tokenization solves this problem by allowing the model to learn reusable linguistic structures instead of memorizing every possible word separately."}],"\n","$L15","\n","$L16","\n","$L17","\n","$L18","\n","$L19","\n","$L1a","\n","$L1b","\n","$L1c","\n","$L1d","\n","$L1e","\n","$L1f","\n","$L20","\n","$L21","\n","$L22","\n","$L23","\n","$L24","\n","$L25","\n","$L26","\n","$L27","\n","$L28","\n","$L29","\n","$L2a","\n","$L2b","\n","$L2c","\n","$L2d","\n","$L2e","\n","$L2f","\n","$L30","\n","$L31","\n","$L32","\n","$L33","\n","$L34","\n","$L35","\n","$L36","\n","$L37","\n","$L38","\n","$L39","\n","$L3a","\n","$L3b","\n","$L3c","\n","$L3d","\n","$L3e","\n","$L3f","\n","$L40","\n","$L41","\n","$L42","\n","$L43","\n","$L44","\n","$L45","\n","$L46","\n","$L47","\n","$L48","\n","$L49","\n","$L4a","\n","$L4b","\n","$L4c","\n","$L4d","\n","$L4e","\n","$L4f","\n","$L50","\n","$L51","\n","$L52","\n","$L53","\n","$L54","\n","$L55","\n","$L56","\n","$L57","\n","$L58","\n","$L59","\n","$L5a","\n","$L5b","\n","$L5c","\n","$L5d","\n","$L5e","\n","$L5f","\n","$L60","\n","$L61","\n","$L62","\n","$L63","\n","$L64","\n","$L65","\n","$L66","\n","$L67","\n","$L68","\n","$L69","\n","$L6a","\n","$L6b","\n","$L6c","\n","$L6d","\n","$L6e","\n","$L6f","\n","$L70","\n","$L71","\n","$L72","\n","$L73","\n","$L74","\n","$L75","\n","$L76","\n","$L77","\n","$L78","\n","$L79","\n","$L7a","\n","$L7b","\n","$L7c","\n","$L7d","\n","$L7e"]
15:["$","p",null,{"children":"Language becomes modular."}]
16:["$","p",null,{"children":"Less like a dictionary."}]
17:["$","p",null,{"children":"More like a system of composable patterns."}]
18:["$","hr",null,{}]
19:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Why AI Does Not Use Individual Characters Either"}]
1a:["$","p",null,{"children":"An opposite strategy would be analyzing text character by character."}]
1b:["$","p",null,{"children":"But that creates another computational problem."}]
1c:["$","p",null,{"children":"The word:"}]
1d:["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-txt","children":"mathematics\n"}]}]
1e:["$","p",null,{"children":"contains eleven separate characters."}]
1f:["$","p",null,{"children":"A character-based model would need to process every single one individually, dramatically increasing sequence length and computational cost."}]
20:["$","p",null,{"children":"Tokens form a mathematical compromise between:\ncomplete words and individual characters."}]
21:["$","p",null,{"children":"They are flexible enough to handle unfamiliar vocabulary, yet compact enough for efficient large-scale neural computation."}]
22:["$","p",null,{"children":"This balance is one of the hidden engineering breakthroughs behind modern language models."}]
23:["$","hr",null,{}]
24:["$","h2",null,{"children":"The Hidden Mathematics of Tokenization"}]
25:["$","p",null,{"children":"Most modern AI systems rely on methods related to:"}]
26:["$","h1",null,{"children":"Byte Pair Encoding (BPE)"}]
27:["$","p",null,{"children":"or similar subword tokenization algorithms."}]
28:["$","p",null,{"children":"The idea is surprisingly elegant."}]
29:["$","p",null,{"children":"Instead of manually teaching language rules, the tokenizer statistically discovers which fragments appear repeatedly across massive datasets."}]
2a:["$","p",null,{"children":"Patterns such as:"}]
2b:["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-txt","children":"ing\ntion\nmath\ngeo\nun\n"}]}]
2c:["$","p",null,{"children":"occur constantly throughout human language."}]
2d:["$","p",null,{"children":"The tokenizer gradually learns that these recurring structures are useful reusable units."}]
2e:["$","p",null,{"children":"In effect, the system compresses language into efficient statistical building blocks."}]
2f:["$","p",null,{"children":"At a deeper level, tokenization is fundamentally connected to:\nprobability, compression, and information theory."}]
30:["$","hr",null,{}]
31:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Claude Shannon and the Compression of Language"}]
32:["$","p",null,{"children":"One of the intellectual foundations behind this idea comes from Claude Shannon, the founder of information theory."}]
33:["$","p",null,{"children":"Shannon demonstrated that communication systems could be studied mathematically through concepts such as entropy, predictability, and statistical structure."}]
34:["$","p",null,{"children":"Human language contains enormous redundancy."}]
35:["$","p",null,{"children":["Some patterns appear constantly.",["$","br",null,{}],"\n","Others are extremely rare."]}]
36:["$","p",null,{"children":"Efficient communication systems therefore attempt to compress recurring structures into reusable representations."}]
37:["$","p",null,{"children":"That is precisely what tokenization does."}]
38:["$","p",null,{"children":"In a sense, tokens are compressed units of linguistic predictability."}]
39:["$","p",null,{"children":"The AI gradually learns which symbolic structures tend to appear together and uses those statistical relationships to model language itself."}]
3a:["$","hr",null,{}]
3b:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Large Language Models Are Prediction Machines"}]
3c:["$","p",null,{"children":"The deepest conceptual shift comes here."}]
3d:["$","p",null,{"children":"Large language models are not primarily retrieving sentences from memory."}]
3e:["$","p",null,{"children":"They are continuously predicting the next token."}]
3f:["$","p",null,{"children":["Again.",["$","br",null,{}],"\n","And again.",["$","br",null,{}],"\n","At enormous scale."]}]
40:["$","p",null,{"children":"If the model sees:"}]
41:["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-txt","children":"2 + 2 =\n"}]}]
42:["$","p",null,{"children":"the probability that the next token is:"}]
43:["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-txt","children":"4\n"}]}]
44:["$","p",null,{"children":"becomes extremely high."}]
45:["$","p",null,{"children":"If it sees:"}]
46:["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-txt","children":"Once upon a\n"}]}]
47:["$","p",null,{"children":"the probability of:"}]
48:["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-txt","children":"time\n"}]}]
49:["$","p",null,{"children":"rises dramatically."}]
4a:["$","p",null,{"children":"Everything the model generates emerges from this process of probabilistic token prediction."}]
4b:["$","p",null,{"children":"At sufficient scale, the result begins to resemble reasoning itself."}]
4c:["$","p",null,{"children":"That resemblance is one reason modern AI systems feel so unsettlingly human."}]
4d:["$","hr",null,{}]
4e:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Context Windows: The AI’s Temporary Memory"}]
4f:["$","p",null,{"children":"Tokens also define the effective memory of a language model."}]
50:["$","p",null,{"children":"When people refer to:\n“128k context,” “1 million tokens,” or “token limits,” they are describing how much information the system can actively process simultaneously."}]
51:["$","p",null,{"children":"Everything must fit inside that token window:\nconversation history, prompts, HTML, code, mathematical notation, JSON, instructions, and generated responses."}]
52:["$","p",null,{"children":"This is why extremely long conversations eventually begin losing earlier details or forgetting context."}]
53:["$","p",null,{"children":"The AI is not remembering abstract ideas independently from language."}]
54:["$","p",null,{"children":"It is managing very large token sequences mathematically."}]
55:["$","hr",null,{}]
56:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Tokens Are Not Just Language"}]
57:["$","p",null,{"children":"One remarkable aspect of token systems is their universality."}]
58:["$","p",null,{"children":"The same architecture can process natural language, programming code, HTML, LaTeX equations, symbolic mathematics, and even emojis."}]
59:["$","p",null,{"children":"For example:"}]
5a:["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-html","children":"<div class=\"hero\">\n"}]}]
5b:["$","p",null,{"children":"also becomes tokens."}]
5c:["$","p",null,{"children":"So does:"}]
5d:["$","pre",null,{"children":["$","code",null,{"className":"language-latex","children":"\\int_0^\\infty e^{-x^2} dx\n"}]}]
5e:["$","p",null,{"children":"To the model, all of these become structured symbolic sequences governed by statistical relationships."}]
5f:["$","p",null,{"children":"That flexibility is one reason modern AI systems became so unexpectedly powerful."}]
60:["$","p",null,{"children":"Everything becomes sequence."}]
61:["$","p",null,{"children":"Everything becomes pattern."}]
62:["$","hr",null,{}]
63:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Does the AI Actually Understand Meaning?"}]
64:["$","p",null,{"children":"This leads directly to one of the deepest philosophical questions in artificial intelligence."}]
65:["$","p",null,{"children":"Do language models genuinely understand anything?"}]
66:["$","p",null,{"children":"Or are they merely manipulating symbols with extraordinary statistical sophistication?"}]
67:["$","p",null,{"children":"Philosopher John Searle explored this problem through the famous “Chinese Room” argument."}]
68:["$","p",null,{"children":"He imagined a person inside a room mechanically manipulating Chinese symbols according to instruction rules, despite not understanding Chinese at all."}]
69:["$","p",null,{"children":"To an outside observer, the room would appear intelligent."}]
6a:["$","p",null,{"children":"Internally, however, there would be no genuine comprehension —\nonly symbolic manipulation."}]

6c:["$","p",null,{"children":"They process tokens with astonishing effectiveness, generate coherent explanations, write code, solve problems, and simulate reasoning."}]
